newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil unions reach preliminary pact - PDVSA.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil unions reach preliminary pact - PDVSA.

text.p: Venezuela's oil unions and state oil company came to a preliminary agreement in talks over the weekend and an extension of last week's industrial unrest is unlikely, a top oil company official said.
However, the preliminary deal still has to be approved by the union's ruling council at a meeting at 1000 local/1400 GMT, he added.

"I do not think there will be any strike this week. We came to a preliminary agreement with the unions after the meetings over the weekend. They are taking the accords to their ruling council and if the council approves them the problem is over," said Fernando Sanchez, personnel coordinator of state-owned Petroleos de Venezuela.
He declined to specify the content of the preliminary accord until it was signed by both parties.

The unions staged an eight-hour strike last Friday, forcing PDVSA to implement contingency plans to maintain normal production and exports. The unions had threatened indefinite action if 14 complaints, including performance-related pay, inflation-related pay rises and contract worker salaries, were not addressed.
